notes.title: v1.1.0 It plays more like a game now
notes.content:
v1.1.0

Greatly optimize the game experience:
1、New game mechanism
 [list]
[*]Use 2-minute countdown mode.
[*]Maximum number of different layers in a game round is limited to 10.
[*]Restricted the use of hints.
[/list]
2、New game interface
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550076/ba7f7faf52b7467ea747c1b102c9ecfe26f9b6c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550076/a458ed7acc01a1814e13836aef3020c0dcd7db91.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550076/c7190957d0f6b0f3c5c189b3ffb40339839d74dc.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550076/7640747ba533823448e4f6fdab482ca4de7cb011.png[/img][/url]

3、More intuitive mouse operation instructions
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550076/147f4a110373c727e2c75277eab7bea90b9d2973.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550076/1bce8c0f07d9bc2ec59ca6f92a1a49dfb52d31cf.png[/img][/url]
4、After starting the game:
 [list]
[*]Added a hint when reading picture resources
[*]Add the effect of picture fading in after reading resources.
[*]The picture is centered by default
[/list]
